scope: Synthetic local-API rehearsal of needs, explicit platform selection, Jubilee design, bed revision, cooling, save/reopen, arm/camera expansion, quantities and confirmation. No hardware, laboratory performance, export timing, or reliability-rate claim.

release_gate.third_path: Safely blocked at platform choice because available equipment was not recorded; the backend requested equipment instead of generating a machine. No later stages were completed.

live_totals.usage_limit: Reported totals exclude the unknown consumption of one interrupted in-flight arm-extraction request. They are a lower bound, not billing or remaining-credit data.
live_totals.latency_limit: Individual provider-request timings and chat-turn sums exclude untimed save/reopen/confirmation overhead. No hardware or export timing is included.

fresh_complete_paths.final_code_evidence: Live run preceded the last parser hardening; all ten recorded responses replayed successfully offline on the fingerprints below.
Live run recorded these exact final code fingerprints.

audited_behaviors: Exact requested bed delta; fixed source identity, frame and purchased-part sizes retained.
Cooling preserved the accepted insert dimensions, placements and bed pose.
Save/reopen rebuilt the same design with no model request.
Arm extension retained the workstation and cold-storage components.
Quantity edits retained accepted layout/proposal/arm; only canonical sample-rack representation followed the target count.

failures_and_limits.event: An arm request repeated a historical platform-choice source; HTTP 502 preserved the project.
failures_and_limits.resolution: Ignore only an exact inert echo of the already recorded choice; new choices still require current-message evidence.

failures_and_limits.event: Full design-dictionary equality rejected the intentional sample-rack change from one to three represented holes after three targets were supplied.
failures_and_limits.resolution: Require exact canonical regeneration from the prior layout and new plan; do not broadly ignore geometry differences.

failures_and_limits.event: An earlier cooling proposal moved five accepted components while claiming to preserve them. A later strict audit also rejected the recovered result from that snapshot.
failures_and_limits.resolution: Explicit relative layout context plus bounded deterministic preservation checks before acceptance; violations receive the existing single correction attempt. No live correction of that specific bad response is claimed.

failures_and_limits.event: One in-flight arm-extraction request was stopped while investigating the harness issue; no provider response or token usage was received.
failures_and_limits.resolution: Count the request against the physical-attempt total; retain consumption as unknown.

failures_and_limits.event: A procurement requirement used the literal descriptive route instead of its canonical enum; HTTP 502 preserved the project.
failures_and_limits.resolution: Closed exact literal aliases normalize procurement format while retaining the source and without selecting a platform.

failures_and_limits.event: A brief value copied the current message exactly but its cited source covered only the trailing words; HTTP 502 preserved the project.
failures_and_limits.resolution: Repair only a current exact literal value span; no paraphrase, changed value, or historical-only source is accepted.

failures_and_limits.event: The third fresh scenario described pipette-based work without explicitly recording available equipment; layout generation was rejected.
failures_and_limits.resolution: Equipment clarification remains required. This scenario is incomplete and is not counted as a successful fresh route.

offline_replay.purpose: Revalidate the earlier successful live responses through final parser, compiler and preservation checks. Historical replay tokens are excluded from live totals.

raw_receipts: All original responses, failed attempts and interrupted-request annotations are retained locally; raw transcripts, runtime IDs, credentials and private paths are omitted from this curated summary.
